summary: Tested DELETE /api/payments/{id} (debt restoration) and supplier debt history (history API, ledger, FIFO purchase_debts, statement PDF, WhatsApp) in both backend and UI, plus a regression check on the customer drawer, customer PDF and the existing debts suite. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass (11 new + 10 regression). UI: all requested flows pass. Deleting a customer payment (75) and a supplier payment (120) through window.confirm removed the row, put the amount back on the balance and showed a toast. The supplier drawer showed the ledger with Blerje + and Pagesë −, a running Gjendja ending at the balance, totals, purchase details (Paguar në blerje / Borxhi i blerjes / FIFO payment / Mbetet), a correct wa.me link, and the PDF A4 button returned 200 application/pdf with 'Kartela e borxhit të furnitorit'. All TEST_ data was cleaned up and no real customer or supplier was touched.

minor.issue: Race condition: find_one then $inc then delete_one is not atomic, so two concurrent deletes could restore the amount twice. Use find_one_and_delete first, then $inc.

After an older payment is deleted, later payments still show their stored balance_before/balance_after. Those numbers are now stale in the history table. Not wrong for the ledger, which is recomputed.

action_items: Optional: make delete_payment atomic using find_one_and_delete
critical_code_review_comments: delete_payment is not atomic (double restore possible under concurrent requests)
Deleted payments leave no audit trail; consider soft-delete or logging who deleted it
server.py is ~1460 lines; consider splitting into routers (payments, suppliers, reports)
